TITLE: FF4 Free Enterprise
DESC: Play Final Fantasy IV: Free Enterprise seeds with a tracker that follows the game: key items, characters, bosses and the seed’s objectives.
BLURB: Roll a seed at ff4fe.com, play the ROM right here on the hub’s Snes9x, and the tracker follows along: the 18 key items (and which are used), characters found, bosses beaten, chests, and the seed’s objectives with live progress, read from the ROM.
FINE: Seeds are made on Free Enterprise’s own site (it patches in your browser there).
